note: The build half of per-invocation identity: the env rewrite of ADR 0010 step 5. Each case replaces process.env with an object, as a harness's per-invocation view does, and checks that every way of reading the environment through Bun reads it. The isolation cases WA-31/a and WA-31/b are the harness's (W1, C3b).

cases.title: Bun.env, Bun["env"], globalThis.Bun.env, global.Bun.env and import.meta.env read process.env
an alias of Bun and destructuring of Bun read process.env (cl P4-2)
everything else on Bun is the real Bun, and its read-only properties stay read-only

result: Attempted to assign to readonly property.

cases.title: a bundled dependency's reads through Bun are rewritten too

given.source:
import { read } from "fixture-env";
export function main() { return read(); }

fixture-env@1.0.0.index.js:
const { env } = Bun;
export const read = () => [env.WL_CASE, Bun.env.WL_CASE];

cases.title: a local binding named Bun is left alone
//native and //nodejs bundles are not rewritten
cases.note: On Windmill these scripts do not run with Bun's globals; their environment is the native boundary's (C3n).

entries.source:
//native
export function main() { return [typeof Bun, Bun.env.WL_CASE, import.meta.env?.WL_CASE]; }

//nodejs
export function main() { return typeof Bun; }

cases.title: the rewrite reads the invocation's environment whatever the script and its dependencies bind
cases.note: A script that spells the binding name moves the build to another one (c2a review 1).

cases.title: a script's own globalThis is its own; a free Bun still reads the view

given.source:
const globalThis = { Bun: { env: { WL_CASE: "own" } } };
export function main() { return [globalThis.Bun.env.WL_CASE, Bun.env.WL_CASE]; }

cases.title: a binding that spells the rewrite's name through a Unicode escape moves the build to another name
cases.note: The script spells the rewrite's first two candidate names only through escapes, which an identifier may use for any character; the collision check decodes them (c2a review 2, finding 6). Without that, Bun.env would read the script's own binding.
